# Support

## Getting Help

If you have questions about using or contributing to BBXDOO, here are the best ways to get support:

### GitHub Discussions

Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/BBXDOO/BBXDOO/discussions) for:

- General questions about the project
- Ideas and feature requests
- Community conversation

### GitHub Issues

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/BBXDOO/BBXDOO/issues) for:

- Bug reports
- Concrete feature requests with clear requirements

### Documentation

Before asking, please check:

- [`README.md`](../README.md) — project overview and quick start
- [`docs/`](../docs/) — detailed documentation
- [`CHANGELOG.md`](../CHANGELOG.md) — recent changes

## Security Issues

For security vulnerabilities, please follow the process described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and **do not** open a public issue.

## Response Time

This is a community-maintained project. We do our best to respond within a reasonable timeframe, but response times may vary.
